subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model turn limits with auto-revert

question: Should OpenClaw add a session-owned multi-turn model lease contract for `/model --turns N`, and should it share semantics with the one-turn Gateway/chat override work?
rationale: The request adds public slash-command, config, and persisted session model-routing semantics; automation can identify the affected paths but should not choose the product contract for turn counting, warnings, auth-profile preservation, and overlap with one-turn overrides.

options.title: Specify a unified lease contract
options.body: Define a maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway/session API shape against that single contract.

options.title: Defer to one-turn API first
options.body: Keep this issue open but require the one-turn override contract to settle before multi-turn leases are designed.

options.title: Do not add native leases
options.body: Reject native turn leases and document manual `/model default` or external operational policy as the supported cost-governance path.

recommendation.title: Specify a unified lease contract
recommendation.body: Define a maintainer-approved session lease design first, then implement `/model --turns N` and any Gateway/session API shape against that single contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is on existing session model override, auth-profile preservation, and Gateway patch paths that would own a lease contract.
